metadata.name: Joint Stock Company Kaspi.kz
metadata.provenance: financials built 23-Nov-26 from Kaspi.kz FY2025 audited & 9M 2026 Nasdaq/KASE filings (Nov-26); quotes await [BBG] capture

financials_multi_year.source: JSC Kaspi.kz FY2025 Audited Financial Statements (KASE / SEC 20-F), read 23-Nov-26

observations.notes: FY25 audited assets KZT 11.08tn (vs 8.38tn FY24), equity KZT 2.60tn (vs 1.57tn), net profit KZT 1,068bn.

financials_multi_year.source: JSC Kaspi.kz 9M 2026 Financial Results (Nasdaq / StockTitan), read 23-Nov-26

observations.notes: 9M26 revenue KZT 3.31tn (vs 2.90tn 9M25), net income KZT 791.8bn (flat YoY vs 790.7bn reflecting Hepsiburada/Türkiye expansion investment), net operating cash flow KZT 1.24tn; gross NPLs KZT 533.4bn (74% coverage).

debt_maturities.source: 5Y USD Senior Unsecured Eurobond (funding diversified beyond local KZT Super App retail/merchant deposits).

verdict.stance: Overweight / High-Margin IG Kazakhstan Super-App Cash Machine (BBB-/Baa3)
verdict.summary: Investment-grade Kazakh fintech/e-commerce giant (Fitch BBB- / Moody's Baa3) generated KZT 1.24tn operating cash flow and KZT 791.8bn net income on KZT 3.31tn revenue in 9M26, even while absorbing Türkiye (Hepsiburada/Hepsi Bank) integration investments. Deep KZT 2.60tn equity and retail deposit funding keep corporate leverage negligible.

positives: Exceptional cash generation: 9M26 net operating cash flow KZT 1.24tn and net margin ~24% (NPAT KZT 791.8bn on KZT 3.31tn revenue).
Dominant Kazakh ecosystem monopoly across Payments, Marketplace, and Fintech; KZT 2.60tn equity base.
Investment-grade ratings (Fitch BBB- / Moody's Baa3) with diversified retail deposit funding.
negatives: Turkish expansion via Hepsiburada / Hepsi Bank introduces FX, macro, and competitive execution drag on consolidated margins.
Consumer fintech loan book NPLs (KZT 533.4bn gross, 74% coverage) require close underwriting discipline.
Kazakhstan regulatory/tax/interchange fee scrutiny and KZT currency risk vs USD bond service.

background.business_overview: Kazakhstan's dominant Super App ecosystem (Nasdaq: KSPI / KASE) integrating Payments, Marketplace, and Fintech (Kaspi Bank).
background.asset_perimeter: Kaspi Bank, Kaspi Pay, Kaspi Marketplace in Kazakhstan plus controlling stake in Hepsiburada (Türkiye).
background.ownership_governance: Nasdaq-listed (KSPI); founders Vyacheslav Kim & Mikheil Lomtadze + Baring Vostok institutional base.

recent_drivers: 9M26 (Nasdaq/KASE): Revenue KZT 3.31tn (vs 2.90tn), NPAT KZT 791.8bn, net operating cash flow KZT 1.24tn, gross NPLs KZT 533.4bn (74% coverage).
2025-2026: FY25 assets KZT 11.08tn, equity KZT 2.60tn, NPAT KZT 1.068tn; integration of Hepsiburada Türkiye.
